title: 試験に出る N1・N2 文字・語彙

items.q: ①彼は、忙しい仕事の間にボランティア（ ）をしている。
items.qr: Kare wa, isogashii shigoto no aida ni borantia (___) o shite iru.
items.en: In between his busy job, he does volunteer work.

opts.en: liveliness, energy, bustle (of a place or group)
shining performance; playing an active, prominent part
making good use of, putting to practical use

items.why: ボランティア活動 is a set compound (the book's notes list クラブ活動・ボランティア活動). 活躍 would mean a star performance, not the activity itself.

items.q: ②あの選手は、オリンピックでの（ ）が期待されている。
items.qr: Ano senshu wa, orinpikku de no (___) ga kitai sarete iru.
items.en: That athlete is expected to shine at the Olympics.

opts.en: liveliness, energy, bustle (of a place or group)
shining performance; playing an active, prominent part
making good use of, putting to practical use

items.why: 活躍を期待する is the book's collocation: 活躍 is doing something well and visibly (athletes, actors). 活動 is just "being active", with no idea of success.

items.q: ③この町は若者が都会に出て行き、すっかり（ ）がなくなってしまった。
items.qr: Kono machi wa wakamono ga tokai ni dete iki, sukkari (___) ga nakunatte shimatta.
items.en: The young people have left this town for the city, and it has lost all its life.

opts.en: liveliness, energy, bustle (of a place or group)
shining performance; playing an active, prominent part
making good use of, putting to practical use

items.why: 活気がある／ない describes the atmosphere of a place or group. 活発 is a な-adjective (活発な町) and does not take が＋なくなる here.

items.q: ④空いている土地を（ ）しようと思って、アパートを建てた。
items.qr: Aite iru tochi o (___) shiyou to omotte, apaato o tateta.
items.en: I wanted to make use of the empty land, so I built an apartment block.

opts.en: liveliness, energy, bustle (of a place or group)
shining performance; playing an active, prominent part
making good use of, putting to practical use

items.why: 〜を活用する = put something you have to good use (the book's example: an old warehouse used as a concert hall). It takes an object (土地を), which 活動 and 活躍 do not.

items.q: ⑤討論会では、（ ）な意見交換がなされた。
items.qr: Touronkai de wa, (___) na iken koukan ga nasareta.
items.en: At the debate there was a lively exchange of opinions.

opts.en: liveliness, energy, bustle (of a place or group)
shining performance; playing an active, prominent part
making good use of, putting to practical use

items.why: The blank is followed by な, so it must be a な-adjective — only 活発 of the five. 活発な議論・活発に発言する are its typical partners.

items.q: ①（ ）にやってみないと、うまくいくかどうかわからない。
items.qr: (___) ni yatte minai to, umaku iku ka dou ka wakaranai.
items.en: You won't know whether it works until you actually try it.

opts.en: realisation; coming true (a dream, a plan)
reality, actual practice; actually, in practice
real (felt) sense, feeling that something is real

items.why: 実際に = "actually, in reality" as an adverb (the book lists 実際の・実際に・実際は). None of the other four is used with に to mean "actually".

items.q: ②口で言うだけで、（ ）が伴わなければ意味がない。
items.qr: Kuchi de iu dake de, (___) ga tomonawanakereba imi ga nai.
items.en: Just saying it is meaningless if it isn't backed up by action.

opts.en: realisation; coming true (a dream, a plan)
reality, actual practice; actually, in practice
real (felt) sense, feeling that something is real

items.why: The contrast is words vs deeds: 実行 = putting what you said into action (計画を実行する). 実現 is the result coming true, not the doing.

items.q: ③医師の国家試験が先日（ ）された。
items.qr: Ishi no kokka shiken ga senjitsu (___) sareta.
items.en: The national medical licensing exam was held the other day.

opts.en: realisation; coming true (a dream, a plan)
reality, actual practice; actually, in practice
real (felt) sense, feeling that something is real

items.why: Official exams, surveys and systems are 実施される (the book's example: 海外で能力試験を実施する). 実行 is used for plans and decisions a person carries out.

items.q: ④子供のころからの夢がやっと（ ）した。
items.qr: Kodomo no koro kara no yume ga yatto (___) shita.
items.en: My childhood dream has finally come true.

opts.en: realisation; coming true (a dream, a plan)
reality, actual practice; actually, in practice
real (felt) sense, feeling that something is real

items.why: 夢が実現する is the book's own collocation. 実現 is the only one of the five that works intransitively with a dream as subject.

items.q: ⑤金メダルをとったが、まだ（ ）がわかない。
items.qr: Kin medaru o totta ga, mada (___) ga wakanai.
items.en: I won the gold medal, but it still doesn't feel real.

opts.en: realisation; coming true (a dream, a plan)
reality, actual practice; actually, in practice
real (felt) sense, feeling that something is real

items.why: 実感がわく = "it sinks in, feels real" (the book's collocation). わく (to well up) is used for feelings, so only 実感 fits.

items.q: ①ブラジルとサッカーの試合をするとは……、勝てる（ ）は全然ないね。
items.qr: Burajiru to sakkaa no shiai o suru to wa......, kateru (___) wa zenzen nai ne.
items.en: A football match against Brazil...? We have no chance at all of winning.

opts.en: outlook, forecast (of how things will develop)
a rough guess, an idea (of something)
prospect of reaching a goal; a target in sight

items.why: 見込みがある／ない = there is / isn't a chance (the book's collocation), often after a verb: 勝てる見込み, 合格の見込み.

items.q: ②この難事件も、証拠が見つかってやっと解決の（ ）が立った。
items.qr: Kono nanjiken mo, shouko ga mitsukatte yatto kaiketsu no (___) ga tatta.
items.en: Now that evidence has been found, even this difficult case finally looks set to be solved.

opts.en: outlook, forecast (of how things will develop)
a rough guess, an idea (of something)
prospect of reaching a goal; a target in sight

items.why: The verb 立つ decides it: めどが立つ = the end is in sight (the book's collocation). 見通しが立つ also exists, but the book pairs 見通し with 明るい・暗い and 見通し is used in ③.

items.q: ③A社との提携を実現させた結果、B社の将来の（ ）は明るくなった。
items.qr: A-sha to no teikei o jitsugen saseta kekka, B-sha no shourai no (___) wa akaruku natta.
items.en: As a result of the tie-up with Company A, Company B's future outlook has brightened.

opts.en: outlook, forecast (of how things will develop)
a rough guess, an idea (of something)
prospect of reaching a goal; a target in sight

items.why: 将来の見通し and 見通しが明るい are both in the book's notes. 見通し is a forecast of how things will develop over time.

items.q: ④初級終了時の漢字習得の（ ）は300字である。
items.qr: Shokyuu shuuryou-ji no kanji shuutoku no (___) wa sanbyaku-ji de aru.
items.en: The guideline for kanji learned by the end of the beginner level is 300 characters.

opts.en: outlook, forecast (of how things will develop)
a rough guess, an idea (of something)
prospect of reaching a goal; a target in sight

items.why: A number given as a rough standard is a 目安 (目安にする). 見当 is a guess you make yourself, not a published guideline.

items.q: ⑤こんな大きいダイヤモンド、いったいいくらするのか（ ）もつかない。
items.qr: Konna ookii daiyamondo, ittai ikura suru no ka (___) mo tsukanai.
items.en: A diamond this big — I can't even guess how much it costs.

opts.en: outlook, forecast (of how things will develop)
a rough guess, an idea (of something)
prospect of reaching a goal; a target in sight

items.why: 見当がつく (here 見当もつかない, "haven't the faintest idea") is the book's collocation; つく only pairs with 見当 in this bank.

items.q: ①雨の日は床がぬれて、（ ）やすい。
items.qr: Ame no hi wa yuka ga nurete, (___) yasui.
items.en: On rainy days the floor gets wet and slippery.
items.why: Wet floor → slipping. 〜やすい attaches to the ます-stem, so すべる becomes すべり.

items.q: ②電車の床に（ ）いる若者をよく見かける。
items.qr: Densha no yuka ni (___) iru wakamono o yoku mikakeru.
items.en: You often see young people squatting on the floor of the train.
items.why: People crouching on a train floor: しゃがむ. 〜ている needs the て-form: しゃがんで.

items.q: ③道路の段差に（ ）転んでしまった。
items.qr: Douro no dansa ni (___) koronde shimatta.
items.en: I tripped on a step in the road and fell over.
items.why: 段差（に）つまずく — your foot catches on something and you stumble. Here it links to 転ぶ with the て-form つまずいて.

items.q: ④今日はとても疲れて、足を（ ）ようにして帰った。
items.qr: Kyou wa totemo tsukarete, ashi o (___) you ni shite kaetta.
items.en: I was so tired today that I dragged myself home.
items.why: 足をひきずる = drag your feet (from tiredness or injury). Before ように the dictionary form stays as it is.

items.q: ⑤あそこの壁に（ ）、たばこを吸っているのが私の兄です。
items.qr: Asoko no kabe ni (___), tabako o sutte iru no ga watashi no ani desu.
items.en: The man leaning against that wall and smoking is my elder brother.
items.why: 壁にもたれる = lean on a wall. It joins the next action with the て-form: もたれて.

items.q: ①空が暗くなってきて、（ ）雨が降り出しそうだ。
items.qr: Sora ga kuraku natte kite, (___) ame ga furidashisou da.
items.en: The sky has grown dark; it looks as if it will start raining any moment.

opts.en: now (when it is too late); after all this time

items.why: The book's tip: いまにも〜そうだ. 降り出しそう ("about to start raining") is the cue.

items.q: ②あの事件の謎は、（ ）解明されていない。
items.qr: Ano jiken no nazo wa, (___) kaimei sarete inai.
items.en: The mystery of that case has still not been solved.

opts.en: now (when it is too late); after all this time

items.why: いまだに + a state that has not changed (here a negative: されていない) — the book's tip. いままで would need a different ending (いままで解明されなかった).

items.q: ③（ ）謝っても、もう遅い。
items.qr: (___) ayamatte mo, mou osoi.
items.en: It's too late to apologise now.

opts.en: now (when it is too late); after all this time

items.why: The book's tip: いまさら〜しても遅い. いまさら always carries "it's too late for that now".

items.q: ④えっ、そうなんですか。私は（ ）パンは英語だと思っていました。
items.qr: E', sou nan desu ka. Watashi wa (___) pan wa eigo da to omotte imashita.
items.en: Oh, really? Until now I thought "pan" (bread) was an English word.

opts.en: now (when it is too late); after all this time

items.why: A belief held up to this moment, now corrected: いままで〜と思っていました. いまだに would mean you still think so.

items.q: ⑤（ ）きっとあの画家の価値が認められる日が来るだろう。
items.qr: (___) kitto ano gaka no kachi ga mitomerareru hi ga kuru darou.
items.en: Some day soon, surely, that painter's worth will be recognised.

opts.en: now (when it is too late); after all this time

items.why: The book's tip: いまにきっと〜だろう — a confident prediction about the future. いまにも is for something about to happen this very moment.

items.q: (1) 話し合いの結果、計画の実行を見送ることにした。（ ）
items.qr: Hanashiai no kekka, keikaku no jikkou o miokuru koto ni shita.
items.en: After discussion, we decided to shelve (not go ahead with) the plan.
items.why: 見送る literally "see off": you let the chance go past without acting, so 計画の実行を見送る ≈ the plan is not carried out (やめる). It does not mean "postpone to a set later date" (遅らせる).

items.q: (2) 電車の運行を見合わせているという情報をニュースで聞いた。（ ）
items.qr: Densha no unkou o miawasete iru to iu jouhou o nyuusu de kiita.
items.en: I heard on the news that train services have been suspended.
items.why: 運行を見合わせる is the standard railway announcement for "services are suspended (for now)" — i.e. 中止している. The trains are not running at all, not just running late.

items.q: ①予備校で、（ ）を固めるためのクラスに入って勉強することにした。
items.qr: Yobikou de, (___) o katameru tame no kurasu ni haitte benkyou suru koto ni shita.
items.en: I decided to join a class at a cram school to firm up my basics.

opts.en: base, footing (of an economy, organisation, life)
the basics, fundamentals (the core everything comes back to)

items.why: 基礎を固める (firm up the foundations) is the book's collocation. The book's tip: 基礎 is what you build on top of; 基本 is the core you keep coming back to.

items.q: ②この公園は、米軍（ ）跡につくられた。
items.qr: Kono kouen wa, beigun (___) ato ni tsukurareta.
items.en: This park was built on the site of a former US military base.

opts.en: base, footing (of an economy, organisation, life)
the basics, fundamentals (the core everything comes back to)

items.why: 米軍 (US forces) + a physical place → 基地 (base). The others are abstract.

items.q: ③建築（ ）が緩和され、木造の3階建てもつくれるようになった。
items.qr: Kenchiku (___) ga kanwa sare, mokuzou no sangai-date mo tsukureru you ni natta.
items.en: The building standards were relaxed, so now even three-storey wooden houses can be built.

opts.en: base, footing (of an economy, organisation, life)
the basics, fundamentals (the core everything comes back to)

items.why: Rules that can be "relaxed" (緩和される) are 基準, standards or criteria. 建築基準(法) is a fixed term.

items.q: ④経済の（ ）がしっかりしていれば、多少の不景気は問題とならない。
items.qr: Keizai no (___) ga shikkari shite ireba, tashou no fukeiki wa mondai to naranai.
items.en: If the economic base is solid, a slight recession is no problem.

opts.en: base, footing (of an economy, organisation, life)
the basics, fundamentals (the core everything comes back to)

items.why: 基盤 is the footing that supports a whole system (経済・生活・組織の基盤). 基礎 also exists for "foundation", but the key gives 基礎 to ① and 基盤 here.

items.q: ⑤彼女の演奏は、（ ）に忠実だ。
items.qr: Kanojo no ensou wa, (___) ni chuujitsu da.
items.en: Her playing is faithful to the fundamentals.

opts.en: base, footing (of an economy, organisation, life)
the basics, fundamentals (the core everything comes back to)

items.why: 基本に忠実 = sticking to the fundamentals, a fixed phrase. 基本 is the "core" the book describes — the model you apply and vary.

items.q: ①若者の間で、予想もしなかったおもしろい（ ）が起きている。
items.qr: Wakamono no aida de, yosou mo shinakatta omoshiroi (___) ga okite iru.
items.en: An interesting, unexpected phenomenon is happening among young people.

opts.en: the scene, the spot where something happens or is done
the place itself, on site, locally
the present state of affairs, status quo

items.why: Something that "happens" (起きている) and can be observed is a 現象 (社会現象).

items.q: ②夢みたいなことばかり言っていないで、もっと（ ）的に考えなさい。
items.qr: Yume mitai na koto bakari itte inaide, motto (___)-teki ni kangaenasai.
items.en: Stop talking only about dreams and think more realistically.

opts.en: the scene, the spot where something happens or is done
the place itself, on site, locally
the present state of affairs, status quo

items.why: 夢 ⇔ 現実 (dream vs reality); 現実的 = realistic. None of the others forms a common 〜的 here.

items.q: ③事件（ ）から立ち去る車が目撃された。
items.qr: Jiken (___) kara tachisaru kuruma ga mokugeki sareta.
items.en: A car was seen leaving the scene of the crime.

opts.en: the scene, the spot where something happens or is done
the place itself, on site, locally
the present state of affairs, status quo

items.why: 事件の現場 is in the book's notes: the exact spot where an incident or work takes place.

items.q: ④来年は収益を伸ばすのは無理で、（ ）維持がやっとだ。
items.qr: Rainen wa shuueki o nobasu no wa muri de, (___) iji ga yatto da.
items.en: Next year we can't increase profits; just keeping things as they are will be hard enough.

opts.en: the scene, the spot where something happens or is done
the place itself, on site, locally
the present state of affairs, status quo

items.why: 現状維持 (maintaining the status quo) is a fixed compound.

items.q: ⑤今度の同窓会は××温泉に決まりました。10日5時、（ ）集合です。
items.qr: Kondo no dousoukai wa ×× onsen ni kimarimashita. Tooka goji, (___) shuugou desu.
items.en: The next reunion will be at the XX hot spring. We meet there, on the 10th at 5 o'clock.

opts.en: the scene, the spot where something happens or is done
the place itself, on site, locally
the present state of affairs, status quo

items.why: 現地集合 = "meet at the destination" (not at a station first) — the book's own example.

items.q: ①現代人の生活は、精神的にも経済的にも（ ）がない。
items.qr: Gendaijin no seikatsu wa, seishinteki ni mo keizaiteki ni mo (___) ga nai.
items.en: Modern life leaves people no room to breathe, mentally or financially.

opts.en: stingy, mean with money; a miser
room to spare, leeway (time, money, mind)

items.why: ゆとりがある／ない (the book's collocation) works for both mind and money — exactly the pair 精神的にも経済的にも.

items.q: ②たとえ（ ）と言われようと、寄付はできない。
items.qr: Tatoe (___) to iwareyou to, kifu wa dekinai.
items.en: Even if people call me stingy, I can't make a donation.

opts.en: stingy, mean with money; a miser
room to spare, leeway (time, money, mind)

items.why: Refusing to donate money → you'd be called けち (stingy). 欲張り is wanting more for yourself, which isn't the point here.

items.q: ③試験の直前になって範囲を調べるなんて、あなたは（ ）ですね。
items.qr: Shiken no chokuzen ni natte han'i o shiraberu nante, anata wa (___) desu ne.
items.en: Only checking what the exam covers right before it? You're very laid-back.

opts.en: stingy, mean with money; a miser
room to spare, leeway (time, money, mind)

items.why: のんき = carefree to the point of being careless — said with mild criticism, as here.

items.q: ④彼は（ ）で、いくら財産があっても満足せず、もっとほしがる。
items.qr: Kare wa (___) de, ikura zaisan ga atte mo manzoku sezu, motto hoshigaru.
items.en: He is greedy: however much wealth he has, he is never satisfied and wants more.

opts.en: stingy, mean with money; a miser
room to spare, leeway (time, money, mind)

items.why: "Never satisfied, always wants more" = 欲張り. けち is about not spending, 欲張り about wanting to have.

items.q: ⑤できるだけ安い食材を買うなど、いつも食費の（ ）に努めている。
items.qr: Dekiru dake yasui shokuzai o kau nado, itsumo shokuhi no (___) ni tsutomete iru.
items.en: I always try to save on food costs, for example by buying the cheapest ingredients.

opts.en: stingy, mean with money; a miser
room to spare, leeway (time, money, mind)

items.why: 節約に努める is the book's collocation. 節約 is positive (sensible saving); けち is the negative label for the same behaviour taken too far.

items.q: ①パンを手で（ ）食べる。
items.qr: Pan o te de (___) taberu.
items.en: I tear the bread with my hands and eat it.

opts.en: to chop finely, mince; to carve
to carve, engrave (彫る); also to dig (掘る)
to tear off (into pieces) by hand
to shave, sharpen (a pencil); to cut back

items.why: 手で (by hand) is the cue: ちぎる is tearing into pieces with your fingers. て-form ちぎって.

items.q: ②りんごの皮を（ ）食べよう。
items.qr: Ringo no kawa o (___) tabeyou.
items.en: Let's peel the apple and eat it.

opts.en: to chop finely, mince; to carve
to carve, engrave (彫る); also to dig (掘る)
to tear off (into pieces) by hand
to shave, sharpen (a pencil); to cut back

items.why: 皮をむく = peel. て-form むいて.

items.q: ③ネギを細かく（ ）、ラーメンの中に入れて食べるとおいしいです。
items.qr: Negi o komakaku (___), raamen no naka ni irete taberu to oishii desu.
items.en: Ramen is tasty with finely chopped spring onion in it.

opts.en: to chop finely, mince; to carve
to carve, engrave (彫る); also to dig (掘る)
to tear off (into pieces) by hand
to shave, sharpen (a pencil); to cut back

items.why: 細かく (finely) + a vegetable → きざむ, chop finely. て-form きざんで.

items.q: ④ナイフで鉛筆を（ ）ことがありますか。
items.qr: Naifu de enpitsu o (___) koto ga arimasu ka.
items.en: Have you ever sharpened a pencil with a knife?

opts.en: to chop finely, mince; to carve
to carve, engrave (彫る); also to dig (掘る)
to tear off (into pieces) by hand
to shave, sharpen (a pencil); to cut back

items.why: 鉛筆をけずる = sharpen a pencil (shave thin layers off). The key accepts けずった (〜たことがある, "have you ever") or けずる (〜ることがある, "do you ever").

items.q: ⑤木を（ ）人形を作ります。
items.qr: Ki o (___) ningyou o tsukurimasu.
items.en: I carve wood to make dolls.

opts.en: to chop finely, mince; to carve
to carve, engrave (彫る); also to dig (掘る)
to tear off (into pieces) by hand
to shave, sharpen (a pencil); to cut back

items.why: 彫る = carve a shape out of wood or stone. て-form ほって. (きざむ can also mean "carve", but it is used in ③.)

items.q: ①予定が（ ）したら、お知らせします。
items.qr: Yotei ga (___) shitara, oshirase shimasu.
items.en: I'll let you know once the schedule is clear.

opts.en: 1. exactly alike 2. all of it, wholesale

items.why: はっきりする = become clear/definite. A plan that is still undecided "becomes clear".

items.q: ②あそこは（ ）した会社だから、信用しても大丈夫でしょう。
items.qr: Asoko wa (___) shita kaisha dakara, shin'you shite mo daijoubu deshou.
items.en: That is a sound, reliable company, so it should be safe to trust them.

opts.en: 1. exactly alike 2. all of it, wholesale

items.why: しっかりした + noun = solid, dependable (person, company, building).

items.q: ③父は母を亡くして、（ ）元気をなくしてしまった。
items.qr: Chichi wa haha o nakushite, (___) genki o nakushite shimatta.
items.en: After losing my mother, my father completely lost his spirit.

opts.en: 1. exactly alike 2. all of it, wholesale

items.why: The book's tip: すっかり〜をなくす / すっかり〜になる — a change that is total.

items.q: ④彼は、先輩の論文を（ ）写して提出した。
items.qr: Kare wa, senpai no ronbun o (___) utsushite teishutsu shita.
items.en: He copied his senior's paper word for word and handed it in.

opts.en: 1. exactly alike 2. all of it, wholesale

items.why: The book gives two meanings of そっくり; this is meaning 2, "all of it, wholesale" (他人の文をそっくり写す).

items.q: ⑤期待が大きかっただけに、この結果には（ ）した。
items.qr: Kitai ga ookikatta dake ni, kono kekka ni wa (___) shita.
items.en: Precisely because my hopes were high, I was disappointed by this result.

opts.en: 1. exactly alike 2. all of it, wholesale

items.why: High expectations → disappointment: がっかりする.

items.q: (1) ここで食事をするのは、ひかえたほうがいい。（ ）
items.qr: Koko de shokuji o suru no wa, hikaeta hou ga ii.
items.en: You had better refrain from eating here.
items.why: ひかえる (控える) = hold back from doing something, out of consideration or caution — here ≈ やめる. (タバコを控える, 外出を控える.)

items.q: (2) 例の商品の件ですが、製造を開始することにしました。（ ）
items.qr: Rei no shouhin no ken desu ga, seizou o kaishi suru koto ni shimashita.
items.en: About that product we talked about — we have decided to start making it.

opts.t: 互いに知っているあの
opts.en: that one we both know about

items.why: 例の = "the … you know about", a topic already shared by speaker and listener. It does not mean "example" in this use.

items.q: ①疲れましたね。ちょっと（ ）しましょう。
items.qr: Tsukaremashita ne. Chotto (___) shimashou.
items.en: We're tired, aren't we? Let's take a short break.

opts.en: holiday, leave (time off work or school)

items.why: ちょっと + in the middle of work → 休憩, the short break (the book's definition: a short rest taken during work or exercise).

items.q: ②本日、従業員の慰安旅行につき、臨時（ ）いたします。
items.qr: Honjitsu, juugyouin no ian ryokou ni tsuki, rinji (___) itashimasu.
items.en: We are closed today for a staff trip.

opts.en: holiday, leave (time off work or school)

items.why: A shop notice: the business is closed → 休業 (臨時休業 = closed for the day, unscheduled).

items.q: ④手術のあと、しばらく（ ）してから仕事に復帰します。
items.qr: Shujutsu no ato, shibaraku (___) shite kara shigoto ni fukki shimasu.
items.en: After the operation I'll rest and recuperate for a while before going back to work.

opts.en: holiday, leave (time off work or school)

items.why: After illness or surgery, rest to rebuild strength → 休養 (the book: 病気が回復した後休養する).

items.q: ⑤（ ）を利用して海外旅行に行くつもりです。
items.qr: (___) o riyou shite kaigai ryokou ni iku tsumori desu.
items.en: I plan to use my holiday to travel abroad.

opts.en: holiday, leave (time off work or school)

items.why: Days off from work or school that you can "use" for travel → 休暇 (休暇をとる, 夏季休暇).

items.q: ①前後左右の（ ）を確認してから発車する。
items.qr: Zengo sayuu no (___) o kakunin shite kara hassha suru.
items.en: Check that it is safe in front, behind and on both sides before pulling away.
items.why: 安全を確認する = make sure it is safe (traffic, machinery). 安心 is a feeling, not something you check.

items.q: ②大都市の（ ）の悪化が問題になっている。
items.qr: Daitoshi no (___) no akka ga mondai ni natte iru.
items.en: Worsening public safety in big cities has become a problem.
items.why: Crime levels of a city or country = 治安 (治安がいい・悪い, 治安の悪化).

items.q: ③彼の仕事は、いい時も悪い時もあって（ ）しない。
items.qr: Kare no shigoto wa, ii toki mo warui toki mo atte (___) shinai.
items.en: His work has good times and bad times; it is never stable.
items.why: Ups and downs ⇔ 安定 (no change, in the good sense — the book's definition).

items.q: ④（ ）に将来の道を選ぶと、後で後悔する。
items.qr: (___) ni shourai no michi o erabu to, ato de koukai suru.
items.en: If you choose your future path without proper thought, you will regret it later.
items.why: 安易に + verb = do something too easily, without thinking (the book: 安易に結論を出す).

items.q: ⑤私が就職すれば、両親も（ ）するだろう。
items.qr: Watashi ga shuushoku sureba, ryoushin mo (___) suru darou.
items.en: If I get a job, my parents will be relieved too.
items.why: Parents stop worrying: 安心する ⇔ 心配する (the book's pair).

items.q: ①首相が同じ国を2回続けて訪問するのは、前例のない特異な（ ）だ。
items.qr: Shushou ga onaji kuni o nikai tsuzukete houmon suru no wa, zenrei no nai tokui na (___) da.
items.en: The Prime Minister visiting the same country twice in a row is an unprecedented, unusual case.

opts.en: time (left) before the next thing; interval

items.why: An event or situation viewed as an instance = ケース (the book: 出来事、状況、事柄).

items.q: ②だれか手伝ってくれないかなあと思っていたら、（ ）よく友達が現れた。
items.qr: Dareka tetsudatte kurenai ka naa to omotte itara, (___) yoku tomodachi ga arawareta.
items.en: Just as I was wishing someone would help me, a friend turned up at exactly the right moment.

opts.en: time (left) before the next thing; interval

items.why: タイミングがいい → adverb タイミングよく ("with good timing"). タイムリー is a な-adjective and would be タイムリーに.

items.q: ③電車が出るまでまだ（ ）があるから、お茶でも飲んでいましょう。
items.qr: Densha ga deru made mada (___) ga aru kara, ocha demo nonde imashou.
items.en: There's still time before the train leaves, so let's have some tea.

opts.en: time (left) before the next thing; interval

items.why: 間（ま）= the time left until the next thing starts (the book's definition). 〜まで間がある.

items.q: ④自分のキャリアを深める良い（ ）だと考え、海外転勤を受け入れた。
items.qr: Jibun no kyaria o fukameru yoi (___) da to kangae, kaigai tenkin o ukeireta.
items.en: Seeing it as a good chance to deepen my career, I accepted the overseas transfer.

opts.en: time (left) before the next thing; interval

items.why: An opportunity = チャンス (機会).

items.q: ⑤学生の関心を引くように、授業ではできるだけ（ ）な話題を提供している。
items.qr: Gakusei no kanshin o hiku you ni, jugyou de wa dekiru dake (___) na wadai o teikyou shite iru.
items.en: To catch the students' interest, I bring the most topical subjects I can into class.

opts.en: time (left) before the next thing; interval

items.why: The blank is followed by な, so it must be the な-adjective タイムリー (topical, right for the moment).

items.q: ①冬になってから夏休みの宿題を出してくるとは、（ ）しまう。
items.qr: Fuyu ni natte kara natsuyasumi no shukudai o dashite kuru to wa, (___) shimau.
items.en: Handing in the summer homework in winter — I'm simply dumbfounded.

opts.en: to long for, admire, dream of

items.why: Something so absurd you can't believe it → あきれる. て-form + しまう: あきれてしまう.

items.q: ②子供のときから映画の世界に（ ）いた。
items.qr: Kodomo no toki kara eiga no sekai ni (___) ita.
items.en: Ever since I was a child I had dreamed of the world of film.

opts.en: to long for, admire, dream of

items.why: 〜にあこがれる = long for, be drawn to. 〜ている → あこがれていた.

items.q: ③この大学の試験に2度も落ちたが、（ ）きれず、また受けることにした。
items.qr: Kono daigaku no shiken ni nido mo ochita ga, (___) kirezu, mata ukeru koto ni shita.
items.en: I failed this university's exam twice, but I couldn't give up, so I decided to take it again.

opts.en: to long for, admire, dream of

items.why: 〜きれない attaches to the ます-stem: あきらめきれない = can't bring yourself to give up.

items.q: ④試験は難しいが、十分勉強したのだから、（ ）ことはない。
items.qr: Shiken wa muzukashii ga, juubun benkyou shita no dakara, (___) koto wa nai.
items.en: The exam is hard, but you studied enough, so there's nothing to be afraid of.

opts.en: to long for, admire, dream of

items.why: 〜ことはない = "there's no need to …"; fear is what you would tell someone not to feel. Dictionary form before こと.

items.q: ⑤あの2人は、美人とハンサムのカップルで、人も（ ）仲だ。
items.qr: Ano futari wa, bijin to hansamu no kappuru de, hito mo (___) naka da.
items.en: Those two — a beauty and a handsome man — are a couple everyone envies.

opts.en: to long for, admire, dream of

items.why: 人もうらやむ仲 = a relationship others envy, a set phrase. Dictionary form before the noun 仲.

items.q: ①言いたいことを言ったら、胸が（ ）した。
items.qr: Iitai koto o ittara, mune ga (___) shita.
items.en: Once I'd said what I wanted to say, I felt relieved.
items.why: The book's tip: in the form すっとする it means your feelings clear up (気持ちが晴れる). 胸がすっとする is the usual phrase.

items.q: ②小さい子供は（ ）していないから、髪の毛を切るのは大変だ。
items.qr: Chiisai kodomo wa (___) shite inai kara, kami no ke o kiru no wa taihen da.
items.en: Small children won't keep still, so cutting their hair is hard work.
items.why: じっとする = keep still (the book: 動かない様子).

items.q: ③彼女はひどくショックを受けている。しばらくは（ ）しておこう。
items.qr: Kanojo wa hidoku shokku o ukete iru. Shibaraku wa (___) shite okou.
items.en: She is badly shaken. Let's leave her alone for a while.
items.why: The book's tip: そっとしておく = leave someone in peace, not talk to them or ask questions.

items.q: ④私は20年前から（ ）ここに住んでいます。
items.qr: Watashi wa nijuunen mae kara (___) koko ni sunde imasu.
items.en: I have lived here ever since twenty years ago.
items.why: 〜から ずっと = continuously since … (長い間続けて).

items.q: ⑤（ ）計算してみたんですが、100万ぐらいはかかりそうです。
items.qr: (___) keisan shite mita n desu ga, hyakuman gurai wa kakarisou desu.
items.en: I did a rough calculation; it looks like it will cost about a million.
items.why: A rough estimate (ぐらい) → ざっと計算する (おおざっぱに, the book's paraphrase).

items.q: (1) 卒業する日が待ち遠しい。（ ）
items.qr: Sotsugyou suru hi ga machidooshii.
items.en: I can't wait for graduation day.
items.why: 待ち遠しい = 待つ + 遠い: the waiting feels long because you want the day to come quickly → 早く来てほしい. ④ is only the fact that it's far off, without the longing.

items.q: (2) 子どもたちの体力がいちじるしく低下しているというデータがある。（ ）
items.qr: Kodomotachi no tairyoku ga ichijirushiku teika shite iru to iu deeta ga aru.
items.en: There is data showing that children's physical strength has declined markedly.
items.why: 著しく = so much that it stands out clearly → 非常に. It is a degree word, not a time word (最近).

items.q: ①最近、疲れやすくなった。体力の（ ）を感じる。
items.qr: Saikin, tsukareyasuku natta. Tairyoku no (___) o kanjiru.
items.en: I get tired easily lately. I can feel the limits of my stamina.

opts.en: limit (of what one can do), breaking point

items.why: 限界を感じる (feel you've reached your limit) is the book's collocation; 限界 is the limit of an ability.

items.q: ②このお菓子は、季節を（ ）して販売される。
items.qr: Kono okashi wa, kisetsu o (___) shite hanbai sareru.
items.en: These sweets are sold for a limited season only.

opts.en: limit (of what one can do), breaking point

items.why: 〜を限定する = limit to a certain range, number or time (季節限定 = seasonal only).

items.q: ③運転する時は、（ ）速度を守らなければならない。
items.qr: Unten suru toki wa, (___) sokudo o mamoranakereba naranai.
items.en: When driving you must keep to the speed limit.

opts.en: limit (of what one can do), breaking point

items.why: 制限速度 (the speed limit) is a fixed compound from the book's notes: a limit imposed by rules.

items.q: ④このカードは（ ）が切れているので、使えません。
items.qr: Kono kaado wa (___) ga kirete iru node, tsukaemasen.
items.en: This card has expired, so it can't be used.

opts.en: limit (of what one can do), breaking point

items.why: 期限が切れる = expire (time limit runs out) — the book's collocation.

items.q: ⑤クレジットカードで簡単にお金は借りられるが、30万円が（ ）だ。
items.qr: Kurejitto kaado de kantan ni okane wa karirareru ga, sanjuuman-en ga (___) da.
items.en: You can easily borrow money on a credit card, but 300,000 yen is the maximum.

opts.en: limit (of what one can do), breaking point

items.why: The maximum amount allowed is 限度 (限度額 = credit limit). 限界 would be the limit of your ability.

items.q: ①両国の（ ）を目的として、サッカーの試合が行われた。
items.qr: Ryoukoku no (___) o mokuteki to shite, sakkaa no shiai ga okonawareta.
items.en: A football match was held to promote goodwill between the two countries.

opts.en: association, socialising; going out with someone

items.why: A friendly match between nations → 親善 (親善試合, 国際親善).

items.q: ②クリスマス会のときは、皆でプレゼントを（ ）した。
items.qr: Kurisumasu-kai no toki wa, mina de purezento o (___) shita.
items.en: At the Christmas party we all swapped presents.

opts.en: association, socialising; going out with someone

items.why: Things (プレゼント) are swapped → 交換する (the book's example).

items.q: ③両国の文化（ ）を促進するため、イベントが開かれている。
items.qr: Ryoukoku no bunka (___) o sokushin suru tame, ibento ga hirakarete iru.
items.en: Events are being held to promote cultural exchange between the two countries.

opts.en: association, socialising; going out with someone

items.why: 文化交流 = cultural exchange between groups of people (the book: 別の地域や組織の人同士が交流する).

items.q: ④今回の首脳会談では、首相の（ ）手腕が問われる。
items.qr: Konkai no shunou kaidan de wa, shushou no (___) shuwan ga towareru.
items.en: This summit will test the Prime Minister's diplomatic skill.

opts.en: association, socialising; going out with someone

items.why: A head of government negotiating with other countries → 外交 (外交手腕 = diplomatic skill).

items.q: ⑤彼は（ ）範囲が広く、いろいろな分野の友人がいる。
items.qr: Kare wa (___) han'i ga hiroku, iroiro na bun'ya no yuujin ga iru.
items.en: He has a wide circle of acquaintances, with friends in many fields.

opts.en: association, socialising; going out with someone

items.why: An individual keeping company with people → 交際 (交際範囲 = circle of acquaintances). 交流 is between groups.

items.q: ①私に書類を渡したはずだと彼女は言うが、いくら考えても（ ）がない。
items.qr: Watashi ni shorui o watashita hazu da to kanojo wa iu ga, ikura kangaete mo (___) ga nai.
items.en: She says she must have handed me the papers, but however hard I think, I have no recollection of it.

opts.en: an idea (of who/what/where), a clue in one's memory

items.why: 心当たりがある／ない = to have / have no idea (in your memory) about something — the book's collocation.

items.q: ②帰国前に一番お世話になった先生と話せなかったのが（ ）だ。
items.qr: Kikoku mae ni ichiban osewa ni natta sensei to hanasenakatta no ga (___) da.
items.en: My one regret is that I couldn't speak to the teacher who helped me most before I went home.

opts.en: an idea (of who/what/where), a clue in one's memory

items.why: Something left undone that you keep thinking about = 心残り.

items.q: ③夜9時以降は何も食べないようにしているとは、良い（ ）ですね。
items.qr: Yoru kuji ikou wa nani mo tabenai you ni shite iru to wa, yoi (___) desu ne.
items.en: You make a point of eating nothing after 9 p.m.? That's a good habit.

opts.en: an idea (of who/what/where), a clue in one's memory

items.why: A habit you keep up on purpose: 心がけが良い (the book's collocation).

items.q: ④人の上に立つなら、他人への（ ）を欠かしてはならない。
items.qr: Hito no ue ni tatsu nara, tanin e no (___) o kakashite wa naranai.
items.en: If you are in charge of people, you must never forget to be considerate of others.

opts.en: an idea (of who/what/where), a clue in one's memory

items.why: 他人への (towards others) → 心くばり, attention to other people's needs.

items.q: ⑤4月から社会人になるんでしょう。もう（ ）はできていますか。
items.qr: Shigatsu kara shakaijin ni naru n deshou. Mou (___) wa dekite imasu ka.
items.en: You start working life in April, don't you? Are you mentally prepared?

opts.en: an idea (of who/what/where), a clue in one's memory

items.why: Being ready for something new: 心構えができる.

items.q: ①犯罪を（ ）ためには、経済の安定も必要だ。
items.qr: Hanzai o (___) tame ni wa, keizai no antei mo hitsuyou da.
items.en: To prevent crime, a stable economy is also needed.

opts.en: to obstruct, get in the way of
to block, close up (a road, a hole)
to move (something) out of the way

items.why: The book's tip: ふせぐ = stop something bad from happening (犯罪・事故・侵略をふせぐ).

items.q: ②すみません。車が通れないので、その自転車を（ ）ください。
items.qr: Sumimasen. Kuruma ga toorenai node, sono jitensha o (___) kudasai.
items.en: Excuse me, cars can't get through — please move that bicycle.

opts.en: to obstruct, get in the way of
to block, close up (a road, a hole)
to move (something) out of the way

items.why: Moving an object out of the way → どける. 〜てください needs どけて.

items.q: ③国家間の問題を解決するのに、できるだけ武力行使は（ ）べきだ。
items.qr: Kokkakan no mondai o kaiketsu suru no ni, dekiru dake buryoku koushi wa (___) beki da.
items.en: In solving problems between nations, the use of force should be avoided as far as possible.

opts.en: to obstruct, get in the way of
to block, close up (a road, a hole)
to move (something) out of the way

items.why: Choosing not to do something (武力行使) = さける. Dictionary form before べき.

items.q: ④彼は議題と関係のない発言をして、会議の進行を（ ）ことが多い。
items.qr: Kare wa gidai to kankei no nai hatsugen o shite, kaigi no shinkou o (___) koto ga ooi.
items.en: He often holds up the meeting by making remarks unrelated to the agenda.

opts.en: to obstruct, get in the way of
to block, close up (a road, a hole)
to move (something) out of the way

items.why: The book's tip: 進行・通行・学習をさまたげる = get in the way of something moving forward.

items.q: ⑤山から落ちてきた大きな岩が、道を（ ）いる。
items.qr: Yama kara ochite kita ookina iwa ga, michi o (___) iru.
items.en: A big rock that fell from the mountain is blocking the road.

opts.en: to obstruct, get in the way of
to block, close up (a road, a hole)
to move (something) out of the way

items.why: Something physically filling a road or opening = ふさぐ. 〜ている → ふさいで. Don't confuse with ふせぐ (prevent) in ①.

items.q: ①（ ）休みもとらずに働いてばかりいたら、体をこわすのは当然です。
items.qr: (___) yasumi mo torazu ni hataraite bakari itara, karada o kowasu no wa touzen desu.
items.en: If you do nothing but work without taking proper rest, of course your health will break down.
items.why: The book's tip: ろくに〜ない = nowhere near enough. Here the negative is 〜ずに (とらずに).

items.q: ②こんなに大変な仕事を、（ ）1人でやったんですか。
items.qr: Konna ni taihen na shigoto o, (___) hitori de yatta n desu ka.
items.en: You did such a hard job all by yourself?
items.why: たった + a number stresses how few (たった1人, たった100円).

items.q: ③私は、外食をすることは（ ）ありません。
items.qr: Watashi wa, gaishoku o suru koto wa (___) arimasen.
items.en: I rarely eat out.
items.why: Frequency + negative: めったに〜ない (the book's tip). ろくに is about amount/quality, not frequency.

items.q: ④10時着の予定ですが、道路事情によっては（ ）遅れるかもしれません。
items.qr: Juuji-chaku no yotei desu ga, douro jijou ni yotte wa (___) okureru kamo shiremasen.
items.en: We're due to arrive at 10, but depending on the roads we may be a little late.
items.why: 多少 = 少しは, "a bit" — with an affirmative verb.

items.q: ⑤これは、（ ）この地域だけの問題ではない。全国規模で考えるべきだ。
items.qr: Kore wa, (___) kono chiiki dake no mondai de wa nai. Zenkoku kibo de kangaeru beki da.
items.en: This is not merely a problem for this area. It should be considered on a national scale.
items.why: The book's tip: 単に〜だけではない = not merely ….

items.q: (1) プレゼンテーションは、案外うまくいった。（ ）
items.qr: Purezenteeshon wa, angai umaku itta.
items.en: The presentation went better than expected.
items.why: 案外 = the result differs from what you expected → 思ったより. Compare (2).

items.q: (2) プレゼンテーションは、案の定うまくいかなかった。（ ）
items.qr: Purezenteeshon wa, an no jou umaku ikanakatta.
items.en: Just as I feared, the presentation didn't go well.
items.why: 案の定 = 思ったとおり, the opposite of 案外. ① and ② are degree words that could also go with うまくいかなかった, but they don't carry "as expected".

items.q: ①職業で人を（ ）してはいけない。
items.qr: Shokugyou de hito o (___) shite wa ikenai.
items.en: You must not discriminate against people because of their job.
items.why: してはいけない + people → treating some as lower = 差別 (the book's definition). 区別 is neutral telling-apart and would not be forbidden.

items.q: ②公私の（ ）は、ちゃんとつけるべきだ。
items.qr: Koushi no (___) wa, chanto tsukeru beki da.
items.en: You should keep a clear line between public and private matters.
items.why: 公私の区別 is the book's own example; 区別をつける = draw the distinction.

items.q: ③これからの社会は、能力による賃金（ ）が広がっていくだろう。
items.qr: Korekara no shakai wa, nouryoku ni yoru chingin (___) ga hirogatte iku darou.
items.en: In future society, wage gaps based on ability will probably widen.
items.why: 賃金格差 (wage gap) is the book's example; a 格差 "widens" (広がる).

items.q: ④現地には（ ）に行って、彼とは向こうで会うことにした。
items.qr: Genchi ni wa (___) ni itte, kare to wa mukou de au koto ni shita.
items.en: We decided to go there separately and meet up when we arrived.
items.why: 別々に〜する = do separately (the book's pattern). Only 別々 is used adverbially with に.

items.q: ⑤ゴミは、ちゃんと（ ）して出しましょう。
items.qr: Gomi wa, chanto (___) shite dashimashou.
items.en: Please sort your rubbish properly before putting it out.
items.why: ごみを分別する (ぶんべつ) is the book's collocation — sorting into burnable, plastic, etc.

items.q: ①成田を出発し、モスクワ（ ）でヨーロッパへ行った。
items.qr: Narita o shuppatsu shi, Mosukuwa (___) de yooroppa e itta.
items.en: I left from Narita and went to Europe via Moscow.

opts.en: the sequence of events, how it came about

items.why: Place + 経由 = via that place.

items.q: ②年金制度が崩壊に至った（ ）を明らかにすべきだ。
items.qr: Nenkin seido ga houkai ni itatta (___) o akiraka ni subeki da.
items.en: They should make clear how the pension system came to collapse.

opts.en: the sequence of events, how it came about

items.why: 経緯 = what happened, how and why, leading up to a result (the book: 経緯を報告する). It is what you "make clear" or "report".

items.q: ③衝撃的な事件も、時間の（ ）とともに忘れられていく。
items.qr: Shougekiteki na jiken mo, jikan no (___) to tomo ni wasurerarete iku.
items.en: Even shocking incidents are forgotten as time passes.

opts.en: the sequence of events, how it came about

items.why: 時間の経過 = the passing of time (the book: 時間が経過する).

items.q: ④（ ）でやめてしまったら、今までの苦労がむだになりますよ。
items.qr: (___) de yamete shimattara, ima made no kurou ga muda ni narimasu yo.
items.en: If you give up halfway, all your efforts so far will be wasted.

opts.en: the sequence of events, how it came about

items.why: 途中でやめる = stop halfway.

items.q: ⑤結果だけではなく、そこに至る（ ）も大切だ。
items.qr: Kekka dake de wa naku, soko ni itaru (___) mo taisetsu da.
items.en: Not only the result but also the process that leads to it is important.

opts.en: the sequence of events, how it came about

items.why: 結果 vs 過程 is the book's own contrast (結果より過程を大切にする).

items.q: ①会社の活性化のためには、新しい（ ）にどんどん取り組んだほうがいい。
items.qr: Kaisha no kasseika no tame ni wa, atarashii (___) ni dondon torikunda hou ga ii.
items.en: To revitalise the company, it should take on new experiments one after another.
items.why: 新しい試み (a new attempt) is the book's collocation.

items.q: ②電車でお年寄りに席を譲りたくなくて、寝た（ ）をしている若者もいる。
items.qr: Densha de otoshiyori ni seki o yuzuritakunakute, neta (___) o shite iru wakamono mo iru.
items.en: Some young people pretend to be asleep on the train because they don't want to give their seat to the elderly.
items.why: 寝た振りをする = pretend to be asleep (the book's own example).

items.q: ③警察の（ ）によると、犯人には共犯者がいるとのことだ。
items.qr: Keisatsu no (___) ni yoru to, hannin ni wa kyouhansha ga iru to no koto da.
items.en: According to the police investigation, the culprit had an accomplice.
items.why: 警察の調べ = the police inquiry — a news-report phrase.

items.q: ④先輩の（ ）に従って、留学生の受け入れ態勢が整っている学校を選んだ。
items.qr: Senpai no (___) ni shitagatte, ryuugakusei no ukeire taisei ga totonotte iru gakkou o eranda.
items.en: Following my senior's advice, I chose a school well set up to receive foreign students.
items.why: 勧めに従う = follow someone's advice (the book's collocation).

items.q: ⑤経済企画庁は、経済は回復の（ ）を見せていると発表した。
items.qr: Keizai kikakuchou wa, keizai wa kaifuku no (___) o misete iru to happyou shita.
items.en: The Economic Planning Agency announced that the economy is showing signs of recovery.
items.why: 回復の兆し (signs of recovery) is the book's example; 兆しを見せる.

items.q: ①子供はあまり（ ）すぎないで、少し放っておくほうがいい。
items.qr: Kodomo wa amari (___) suginaide, sukoshi hootte oku hou ga ii.
items.en: It's better not to fuss over children too much — leave them alone a bit.

opts.en: to startle, frighten (as a joke); threaten
to fuss over, pay attention to

items.why: The opposite of 放っておく (leave alone) is かまう (fuss over). 〜すぎる takes the ます-stem: かまいすぎる.

items.q: ②「きゃー！ ……なーんだ、おもちゃのへびか。（ ）ないでよ」
items.qr: "Kyaa! ......Naan da, omocha no hebi ka. (___) naide yo"
items.en: "Eek! …Oh, it's just a toy snake. Don't scare me like that!"

opts.en: to startle, frighten (as a joke); threaten
to fuss over, pay attention to

items.why: A prank that frightens someone = おどかす. 〜ないで needs the ない-form: おどかさないで.

items.q: ③駅のホームで友達と（ ）いたら、もう少しでホームから落ちそうになった。
items.qr: Eki no hoomu de tomodachi to (___) itara, mou sukoshi de hoomu kara ochisou ni natta.
items.en: I was messing about with friends on the platform and nearly fell off it.

opts.en: to startle, frighten (as a joke); threaten
to fuss over, pay attention to

items.why: 友達とふざける = fool around together. 〜ている → ふざけていたら.

items.q: ④彼は、恋人のことを「妹だ」と言って、私たちを（ ）た。
items.qr: Kare wa, koibito no koto o "imouto da" to itte, watashitachi o (___) ta.
items.en: He fooled us by saying his girlfriend was his sister.

opts.en: to startle, frighten (as a joke); threaten
to fuss over, pay attention to

items.why: Telling a lie so people believe it = だます. Before た: だました.

items.q: ⑤「先生、口紅の色を変えたでしょう。恋人でもできたんですか」と（ ）れた。
items.qr: "Sensei, kuchibeni no iro o kaeta deshou. Koibito demo dekita n desu ka" to (___) reta.
items.en: "Teacher, you've changed your lipstick colour, haven't you? Have you got a boyfriend?" — I was teased.

opts.en: to startle, frighten (as a joke); threaten
to fuss over, pay attention to

items.why: Light-hearted teasing = からかう. Passive からかわれる → からかわれた.

items.q: ①大学院に行くか、（ ）就職するか、今悩んでいます。
items.qr: Daigakuin ni iku ka, (___) shuushoku suru ka, ima nayande imasu.
items.en: I'm torn between going to graduate school or getting a job.
items.why: A choice between two (〜か、それとも〜か) — the book: どちらを選択するか.

items.q: ②事件は、すぐ解決すると思った。（ ）3年たっても犯人は捕まらない。
items.qr: Jiken wa, sugu kaiketsu suru to omotta. (___) sannen tatte mo hannin wa tsukamaranai.
items.en: I thought the case would be solved quickly. Yet three years on, the culprit still hasn't been caught.
items.why: 〜と思った。ところが… = something contrary to expectation happened (the book's definition).

items.q: ③学生：先生、遠足に行きましょう。 先生：いいですよ。（ ）全員がレポートを出したらですよ。
items.qr: Gakusei: Sensei, ensoku ni ikimashou. Sensei: Ii desu yo. (___) zen'in ga repooto o dashitara desu yo.
items.en: Student: Sir, let's go on an outing. Teacher: All right — but only once everyone has handed in their report.
items.why: A condition attached to a yes = ただし (the book: 条件や例外を言い添える).

items.q: ④説明は以上です。（ ）場内を見学なさる方は、ここでお待ちください。
items.qr: Setsumei wa ijou desu. (___) jounai o kengaku nasaru kata wa, koko de omachi kudasai.
items.en: That concludes the explanation. Those who wish to tour the site, please wait here.
items.why: An extra piece of information after the main message = なお (the book: 付け加える).

items.q: ⑤私、ガンで入院したんです。（ ）発見が早かったので心配ないですが。
items.qr: Watashi, gan de nyuuin shita n desu. (___) hakken ga hayakatta node shinpai nai desu ga.
items.en: I was in hospital with cancer. Mind you, it was caught early, so there's nothing to worry about.
items.why: The listener will now picture something serious; もっとも softens that impression (the book: 相手の抱いたイメージを修正する). It often ends in 〜が／〜けど, as here.

items.q: (1) 子どものときからの夢がかなった。（ ）
items.qr: Kodomo no toki kara no yume ga kanatta.
items.en: My childhood dream came true.
items.why: 夢がかなう (叶う) = 夢が実現する (see 第1日目 Ⅰ(2)④).

items.q: (2) 彼は、変わった服装をしている。（ ）
items.qr: Kare wa, kawatta fukusou o shite iru.
items.en: He is wearing unusual clothes.
items.why: Before a noun, 変わった is an adjective meaning "unusual, odd" (変わった人, 変わった味) — not "changed". ① and ② are the trap: they read 変わった as the past tense of 変わる.

items.q: ①この問題には、（ ）に対処する必要がある。
items.qr: Kono mondai ni wa, (___) ni taisho suru hitsuyou ga aru.
items.en: This problem needs to be handled carefully.

opts.en: serious, grave (a problem hard to solve)

items.why: Handling something with care = 慎重に (the book: 壊れやすい物を慎重に扱う). 真剣に would be "earnestly", which the key keeps for ⑤.

items.q: ②両国の話し合いは、（ ）な局面を迎えた。
items.qr: Ryoukoku no hanashiai wa, (___) na kyokumen o mukaeta.
items.en: The talks between the two countries have reached a critical stage.

opts.en: serious, grave (a problem hard to solve)

items.why: A decisive stage or moment = 重大な局面 (the book: 重大な場面).

items.q: ③外国で1年を過ごしたことは、（ ）な経験だった。
items.qr: Gaikoku de ichinen o sugoshita koto wa, (___) na keiken datta.
items.en: Spending a year abroad was a valuable experience.

opts.en: serious, grave (a problem hard to solve)

items.why: A precious, valuable experience = 貴重な経験. The other four don't describe value.

items.q: ④フリーターの増加は、（ ）な社会問題になっている。
items.qr: Furiitaa no zouka wa, (___) na shakai mondai ni natte iru.
items.en: The rise in "freeters" (job-hoppers) has become a serious social problem.

opts.en: serious, grave (a problem hard to solve)

items.why: 深刻な問題 is the book's collocation: a problem that runs deep and is hard to solve.

items.q: ⑤学生たちは、自分の課題に（ ）に取り組んでいる。
items.qr: Gakuseitachi wa, jibun no kadai ni (___) ni torikunde iru.
items.en: The students are working on their assignments in earnest.

opts.en: serious, grave (a problem hard to solve)

items.why: 真剣に取り組む is the book's collocation (本気で = in earnest).

items.q: ①この薬は、消化（ ）にとてもよく効きます。
items.qr: Kono kusuri wa, shouka (___) ni totemo yoku kikimasu.
items.en: This medicine works very well for indigestion.

opts.en: defect, flaw (in a machine or product)
fault, weak point (of a person's character etc.)

items.why: 消化不良 (indigestion) is a fixed compound: 不良 = in poor condition.

items.q: ②書類に（ ）があると手続きできない。
items.qr: Shorui ni (___) ga aru to tetsuzuki dekinai.
items.en: If anything is missing from your documents, the procedure can't go ahead.

opts.en: defect, flaw (in a machine or product)
fault, weak point (of a person's character etc.)

items.why: 書類に不備がある is the book's own example: something incomplete or missing.

items.q: ③A社の車には（ ）があることが分かり、即時回収された。
items.qr: A-sha no kuruma ni wa (___) ga aru koto ga wakari, sokuji kaishuu sareta.
items.en: Company A's cars were found to have a defect and were recalled immediately.

opts.en: defect, flaw (in a machine or product)
fault, weak point (of a person's character etc.)

items.why: A fault in how a machine or product works = 欠陥 (the book: 欠陥車, 欠陥商品).

items.q: ④多くの（ ）を乗り越え、彼は会社を再建した。
items.qr: Ooku no (___) o norikoe, kare wa kaisha o saiken shita.
items.en: Overcoming many difficulties, he rebuilt the company.

opts.en: defect, flaw (in a machine or product)
fault, weak point (of a person's character etc.)

items.why: 困難を乗り越える = overcome hardships.

items.q: ⑤彼女の（ ）は、怒りっぽいことです。
items.qr: Kanojo no (___) wa, okorippoi koto desu.
items.en: Her weak point is that she is quick-tempered.

opts.en: defect, flaw (in a machine or product)
fault, weak point (of a person's character etc.)

items.why: A flaw in a person's character = 欠点 (the book: 自分の欠点を知る). 欠陥 is for machines and products.

items.q: ①資金が（ ）をついてしまい、事業を存続させることができなくなった。
items.qr: Shikin ga (___) o tsuite shimai, jigyou o sonzoku saseru koto ga dekinaku natta.
items.en: The funds ran out, and the business could no longer be kept going.
items.why: 底をつく = hit the bottom, run out (the book: 資金が底をついた).

items.q: ②運動会の100メートル走で（ ）だったからといって、悲観することはない。
items.qr: Undoukai no hyaku meetoru-sou de (___) datta kara to itte, hikan suru koto wa nai.
items.en: Just because you came last in the 100 metres on sports day, there's no need to despair.
items.why: Last place in a race = びり (the book: 運動会でびりになった).

items.q: ③東京で4月に雪がふるというのは非常に（ ）だが、全くないわけではない。
items.qr: Toukyou de shigatsu ni yuki ga furu to iu no wa hijou ni (___) da ga, mattaku nai wake de wa nai.
items.en: Snow in Tokyo in April is very rare, but it's not unheard of.
items.why: まれ = rare (the book: まれな現象). 全くないわけではない (not completely unknown) confirms it.

items.q: ④うちの母は、愚痴を言い始めると（ ）がない。
items.qr: Uchi no haha wa, guchi o iihajimeru to (___) ga nai.
items.en: Once my mother starts grumbling, there's no end to it.
items.why: きりがない = endless (the book: 人間の欲望にはきりがない).

items.q: ①子供やお年寄りが、回転ドアに（ ）れる事故が多いそうだ。
items.qr: Kodomo ya otoshiyori ga, kaiten doa ni (___) reru jiko ga ooi sou da.
items.en: Apparently there are many accidents where children and elderly people get caught in revolving doors.

opts.en: to grab, grasp (also: grasp the point)
to grip, hold in the hand
to pick up between the fingers, pinch
to put between; (passive) get caught in

items.why: Being caught between the door and the frame: passive はさまれる.

items.q: ②この薬を飲んだら1か月で30kgやせる、という彼の話に、みんな首を（ ）。
items.qr: Kono kusuri o nondara ikkagetsu de sanjukkiro yaseru, to iu kare no hanashi ni, minna kubi o (___).
items.en: When he said this medicine would make you lose 30 kg in a month, everyone was sceptical.

opts.en: to grab, grasp (also: grasp the point)
to grip, hold in the hand
to pick up between the fingers, pinch
to put between; (passive) get caught in

items.why: 首をひねる = tilt your head in doubt — an idiom. The sentence ends in the past: ひねった.

items.q: ③救急車が来るまでの間、けがをした人の手を（ ）いてあげた。
items.qr: Kyuukyuusha ga kuru made no aida, kega o shita hito no te o (___) ite ageta.
items.en: Until the ambulance came, I held the injured person's hand.

opts.en: to grab, grasp (also: grasp the point)
to grip, hold in the hand
to pick up between the fingers, pinch
to put between; (passive) get caught in

items.why: Holding someone's hand firmly in yours = 手をにぎる. 〜ていてあげる → にぎって.

items.q: ④子供が小さい指で豆を上手に（ ）いる。
items.qr: Kodomo ga chiisai yubi de mame o jouzu ni (___) iru.
items.en: The child is cleverly picking up beans with its little fingers.

opts.en: to grab, grasp (also: grasp the point)
to grip, hold in the hand
to pick up between the fingers, pinch
to put between; (passive) get caught in

items.why: Fingertips + something small (豆) → つまむ. て-form つまんで.

items.q: ⑤長い文章ですが、要点はだいたい（ ）ことができました。
items.qr: Nagai bunshou desu ga, youten wa daitai (___) koto ga dekimashita.
items.en: It's a long text, but I was able to grasp the main points.

opts.en: to grab, grasp (also: grasp the point)
to grip, hold in the hand
to pick up between the fingers, pinch
to put between; (passive) get caught in

items.why: つかむ also means "grasp" an idea: 要点をつかむ. Dictionary form before ことができる.

items.q: ①こんな利益の少ない仕事、（ ）やめてしまおうかと思う。
items.qr: Konna rieki no sukunai shigoto, (___) yamete shimaou ka to omou.
items.en: A job with such low profits — I'm thinking I might as well quit altogether.

opts.en: with much trouble; kindly (don't waste it)
rather, might as well (go to the extreme)
at any rate, you see (emphasising the reason)

items.why: Fed up, you consider the extreme option: いっそ〜てしまおうか (the book: いっそ死んでしまいたい).

items.q: ②（ ）外国語でスピーチをするのは初めてですから、緊張しています。
items.qr: (___) gaikokugo de supiichi o suru no wa hajimete desu kara, kinchou shite imasu.
items.en: After all, it's my first time giving a speech in a foreign language, so I'm nervous.

opts.en: with much trouble; kindly (don't waste it)
rather, might as well (go to the extreme)
at any rate, you see (emphasising the reason)

items.why: なにしろ stresses the reason (〜から) behind a situation (the book: とにかく, 強める気持ち).

items.q: ③彼は（ ）車をぶつけて、保険金をだまし取った。
items.qr: Kare wa (___) kuruma o butsukete, hokenkin o damashitotta.
items.en: He crashed his car on purpose and swindled the insurance money.

opts.en: with much trouble; kindly (don't waste it)
rather, might as well (go to the extreme)
at any rate, you see (emphasising the reason)

items.why: Insurance fraud needs intent → わざと (意図して).

items.q: ④A：山田さん、いらっしゃいますか。 B：山田は（ ）外出中です。
items.qr: A: Yamada-san, irasshaimasu ka. B: Yamada wa (___) gaishutsuchuu desu.
items.en: A: Is Mr Yamada there? B: I'm afraid he is out at the moment.

opts.en: with much trouble; kindly (don't waste it)
rather, might as well (go to the extreme)
at any rate, you see (emphasising the reason)

items.why: Bad timing for the other person: あいにく (the book: 行ったがあいにく留守だった). A standard phone/office phrase.

items.q: ⑤（ ）お誘いいただいたのに残念ですが、今度の土曜日はちょっと……。
items.qr: (___) osasoi itadaita no ni zannen desu ga, kondo no doyoubi wa chotto......
items.en: It's a shame, after you kindly invited me, but this Saturday is a bit difficult…

opts.en: with much trouble; kindly (don't waste it)
rather, might as well (go to the extreme)
at any rate, you see (emphasising the reason)

items.why: せっかく〜のに = it's a pity to waste someone's effort or kindness (the book's definition). A polite way to decline.

items.q: (1) 私は、次の社長はA氏だと思い込んでいた。（ ）
items.qr: Watashi wa, tsugi no shachou wa A-shi da to omoikonde ita.
items.en: I had been convinced that Mr A would be the next president.
items.why: 思い込む = believe something firmly (often wrongly) without checking → 信じて疑わなかった. It is about your own mind, not about saying it to others (主張, うわさ).

items.q: (2) 今日のもうけを計算してみよう。（ ）
items.qr: Kyou no mouke o keisan shite miyou.
items.en: Let's work out today's profit.
items.why: もうけ (儲け) = money made, profit → 利益. 損失 is its opposite.

items.q: ①老朽化の進んだあの建物は、今（ ）工事が行われている。
items.qr: Roukyuuka no susunda ano tatemono wa, ima (___) kouji ga okonawarete iru.
items.en: That ageing, run-down building is now undergoing renovation work.

opts.en: repair and renovation (of a building, road etc.)

items.why: Buildings are 改修 (the book: 建築物を改修する). 改良 is for breeds and machines, not buildings.

items.q: ②米は品種（ ）を重ね、寒いところでも栽培できるようになった。
items.qr: Kome wa hinshu (___) o kasane, samui tokoro demo saibai dekiru you ni natta.
items.en: Through repeated breed improvement, rice can now be grown even in cold places.

opts.en: repair and renovation (of a building, road etc.)

items.why: 品種改良 is the fixed compound (the book: 品種、機器を改良する).

items.q: ③社会における女性の待遇は（ ）されつつあるが……。
items.qr: Shakai ni okeru josei no taiguu wa (___) saretsutsu aru ga......
items.en: The treatment of women in society is gradually improving, but…

opts.en: repair and renovation (of a building, road etc.)

items.why: Conditions such as 待遇 get 改善 (the book: 待遇、生活などを改善する).

items.q: ④この辞書は、最近（ ）版が出版された。
items.qr: Kono jisho wa, saikin (___) ban ga shuppan sareta.
items.en: A revised edition of this dictionary came out recently.

opts.en: repair and renovation (of a building, road etc.)

items.why: Books and printed texts are 改訂 → 改訂版 (revised edition).

items.q: ⑤教育制度の（ ）が必要なのではないだろうか。
items.qr: Kyouiku seido no (___) ga hitsuyou na no de wa nai darou ka.
items.en: Isn't reform of the education system needed?

opts.en: repair and renovation (of a building, road etc.)

items.why: Systems and politics are 改革 (the book: 政治、制度などを改革する) — a sweeping change of structure.

items.q: ①彼は画家として有名になってからも、以前と同じ（ ）な生活を送っていた。
items.qr: Kare wa gaka to shite yuumei ni natte kara mo, izen to onaji (___) na seikatsu o okutte ita.
items.en: Even after becoming famous as a painter, he lived the same frugal life as before.

opts.en: concise, brief and to the point
simple, stripped of waste and decoration

items.why: Living without spending much money = 質素な生活 (the book's example).

items.q: ②この本の説明は、（ ）でだれにでもわかりやすい。
items.qr: Kono hon no setsumei wa, (___) de dare ni demo wakariyasui.
items.en: The explanations in this book are concise and easy for anyone to understand.

opts.en: concise, brief and to the point
simple, stripped of waste and decoration

items.why: Writing that is short and well organised = 簡潔 (the book: 簡潔な文章).

items.q: ③リンゴはなぜ落ちるか、という（ ）な疑問が万有引力の発見につながった。
items.qr: Ringo wa naze ochiru ka, to iu (___) na gimon ga ban'yuu inryoku no hakken ni tsunagatta.
items.en: The simple question "why does an apple fall?" led to the discovery of universal gravitation.

opts.en: concise, brief and to the point
simple, stripped of waste and decoration

items.why: A naive, basic question = 素朴な疑問. The others describe lifestyle, writing or procedures, not a question.

items.q: ④入学願書などは、（ ）書留で郵送する。
items.qr: Nyuugaku gansho nado wa, (___) kakitome de yuusou suru.
items.en: Things like admission applications are sent by simplified registered mail.

opts.en: concise, brief and to the point
simple, stripped of waste and decoration

items.why: 簡易書留 is the name of a Japanese postal service (the book's example).

items.q: ⑤人件費を減らすため、業務の（ ）化を図る。
items.qr: Jinkenhi o herasu tame, gyoumu no (___) ka o hakaru.
items.en: To cut personnel costs, we aim to streamline operations.

opts.en: concise, brief and to the point
simple, stripped of waste and decoration

items.why: Cutting out waste from work = 簡素化 (the book: 事務を簡素化する).

items.q: ①結婚式のスピーチで何か気の利いたことを言いたいと思ったが、やはり（ ）なことしか言えなかった。
items.qr: Kekkonshiki no supiichi de nanika ki no kiita koto o iitai to omotta ga, yahari (___) na koto shika ienakatta.
items.en: I wanted to say something witty in my wedding speech, but in the end I could only say commonplace things.
items.why: The opposite of 気の利いた (witty) is 月並み — ordinary, nothing fresh (the book: 月並みな表現).

items.q: ②勉強を（ ）にしてアルバイトに精を出すとは、本末転倒ではないか。
items.qr: Benkyou o (___) ni shite arubaito ni sei o dasu to wa, honmatsu tentou de wa nai ka.
items.en: Neglecting your studies to throw yourself into a part-time job — isn't that putting the cart before the horse?
items.why: 〜をなおざりにする = neglect (the book: 家庭をなおざりにする). そまつにする is about treating objects carelessly.

items.q: ③昔は食べ物を（ ）にすると、しかられたものだ。
items.qr: Mukashi wa tabemono o (___) ni suru to, shikarareta mono da.
items.en: In the old days, you got scolded if you wasted food.
items.why: Not treating something with care = そまつにする (the book: 食べ物をそまつに扱う).

items.q: ④話の（ ）が合わなかったことから、彼の犯行が明らかになった。
items.qr: Hanashi no (___) ga awanakatta koto kara, kare no hankou ga akiraka ni natta.
items.en: Because his story didn't add up, his crime came to light.
items.why: 話のつじつまが合わない is the book's own collocation.

items.q: ⑤突然激しい雨が降ってきて、新しいスーツが（ ）になってしまった。
items.qr: Totsuzen hageshii ame ga futte kite, atarashii suutsu ga (___) ni natte shimatta.
items.en: Suddenly it poured, and my new suit was ruined.
items.why: 〜が台無しになる = be ruined (the book: 服がぬれて台無しになる).

items.q: ①犯人は死体を山の中に（ ）と言っている。
items.qr: Hannin wa shitai o yama no naka ni (___) to itte iru.
items.en: The culprit says he buried the body in the mountains.

opts.en: to fit in, put on (a ring, gloves); force into

items.why: Putting something under the ground = うめる (埋める). A past act being reported → うめた.

items.q: ②このスカートにあのジャケットを（ ）と素敵だろう。
items.qr: Kono sukaato ni ano jaketto o (___) to suteki darou.
items.en: That jacket would look lovely with this skirt.

opts.en: to fit in, put on (a ring, gloves); force into

items.why: Combining clothes = AにBをあわせる (合わせる). Dictionary form before と.

items.q: ③犠牲者の遺体の上には、青いシートが（ ）ある。
items.qr: Giseisha no itai no ue ni wa, aoi shiito ga (___) aru.
items.en: A blue sheet has been laid over the victims' bodies.

opts.en: to fit in, put on (a ring, gloves); force into

items.why: Covering something from above = かぶせる; 〜てある for the resulting state → かぶせてある.

items.q: ④傷口を手で（ ）、血を止めた。
items.qr: Kizuguchi o te de (___), chi o tometa.
items.en: I pressed the wound with my hand and stopped the bleeding.

opts.en: to fit in, put on (a ring, gloves); force into

items.why: Pressing down with the hand = おさえる (押さえる). て-form joins the next clause.

items.q: ⑤子供を型に（ ）ような教育はよくないと言われる。
items.qr: Kodomo o kata ni (___) you na kyouiku wa yoku nai to iwareru.
items.en: It is said that education that forces children into a mould is not good.

opts.en: to fit in, put on (a ring, gloves); force into

items.why: 型にはめる = squeeze into a fixed pattern — an idiom.

items.q: ①今日は雲ひとつない青空が広がり、富士山が（ ）見える。
items.qr: Kyou wa kumo hitotsu nai aozora ga hirogari, Fujisan ga (___) mieru.
items.en: Today the sky is cloudless and Mt Fuji stands out clearly.
items.why: A clear outline you can see = くっきり見える (the book: 遠くの山がくっきり見える).

items.q: ②このところ忙しくて……。予定が（ ）詰まっているんです。
items.qr: Kono tokoro isogashikute...... Yotei ga (___) tsumatte iru n desu.
items.en: I've been busy lately… My schedule is packed solid.
items.why: 詰まっている (packed) pairs with ぎっしり — no gaps at all.

items.q: ③事件は一応解決した。でも、なんとなく（ ）しない。
items.qr: Jiken wa ichiou kaiketsu shita. Demo, nantonaku (___) shinai.
items.en: The case is more or less solved. But somehow I don't feel satisfied.
items.why: すっきりしない = something still bothers you; the feeling is not clear.

items.q: ④彼は「いくら頼まれてもこれだけは引き受けられない」と（ ）断った。
items.qr: Kare wa "ikura tanomarete mo kore dake wa hikiukerarenai" to (___) kotowatta.
items.en: He flatly refused: "No matter how often you ask, this is the one thing I can't take on."
items.why: Refusing clearly in a strong tone = きっぱり断る (the book's example).

items.q: ⑤容疑者は刑事に問いつめられると、（ ）白状した。
items.qr: Yougisha wa keiji ni toitsumerareru to, (___) hakujou shita.
items.en: When the detective pressed him, the suspect confessed without a fight.
items.why: Quickly, without resistance = あっさり (the book: あっさりあきらめた).

items.q: (1) 私の子どもは18歳だが、精神的にはおさない。（ ）
items.qr: Watashi no kodomo wa juuhassai da ga, seishinteki ni wa osanai.
items.en: My child is 18, but emotionally still immature.
items.why: おさない (幼い) = very young, or childish for one's age → 子どもっぽい. (The book prints the four options as ①②③②; the 4th is obviously ④.)

items.q: (2) 事故の被害者には、だれもが同情した。（ ）
items.qr: Jiko no higaisha ni wa, dare mo ga doujou shita.
items.en: Everyone felt sympathy for the accident victims.
items.why: 同情する = feel pity for someone's suffering → かわいそうに思う. Don't be misled by 同 into "same" (①②). (The book again prints the 4th option as ②.)

items.q: ①泥棒は、窓から（ ）したらしい。
items.qr: Dorobou wa, mado kara (___) shita rashii.
items.en: It seems the burglar got in through the window.
items.why: Entering someone else's space illegally = 侵入 (the book: 泥棒が家に侵入する).

items.q: ②この保険に（ ）しておくと、将来何があっても安心だ。
items.qr: Kono hoken ni (___) shite oku to, shourai nani ga atte mo anshin da.
items.en: If you take out this insurance, you'll be safe whatever happens in future.
items.why: Joining insurance = 保険に加入する (the book's example). 勧誘 is what the salesperson does to you.

items.q: ③他国の内部のことに口を出すのは、内政（ ）だ。
items.qr: Takoku no naibu no koto ni kuchi o dasu no wa, naisei (___) da.
items.en: Poking your nose into another country's internal matters is interference in its domestic affairs.
items.why: 内政干渉 is a fixed compound (the book lists it).

items.q: ④円高が進み過ぎないよう、日本銀行が（ ）する。
items.qr: Endaka ga susumisuginai you, Nippon Ginkou ga (___) suru.
items.en: The Bank of Japan intervenes so the yen doesn't get too strong.
items.why: Stepping in between to change the course of events = 介入 (市場介入, 軍事介入).

items.q: ⑤大学に入ったとき、いろいろなサークルから（ ）された。
items.qr: Daigaku ni haitta toki, iroiro na saakuru kara (___) sareta.
items.en: When I entered university, all sorts of clubs tried to recruit me.
items.why: Being urged to join a club = サークルに勧誘される (the book's example).

items.q: ①犬を飼って、（ ）を紛らわせている。
items.qr: Inu o katte, (___) o magirawasete iru.
items.en: I keep a dog to take my mind off my loneliness.

opts.en: independence, standing on one's own feet

items.why: A feeling you can distract yourself from = 孤独 (the book: 孤独を感じる). 孤立 is a situation, not a feeling.

items.q: ②国際社会で（ ）する国をなくさなければならない。
items.qr: Kokusai shakai de (___) suru kuni o nakusanakereba naranai.
items.en: We must make sure no country is left isolated in the international community.

opts.en: independence, standing on one's own feet

items.why: Being cut off from others in a group = 孤立する (the book: クラスの中で孤立する).

items.q: ③こんなに給料が安くては、（ ）しようにもできない。
items.qr: Konna ni kyuuryou ga yasukute wa, (___) shiyou ni mo dekinai.
items.en: With pay this low, I couldn't become independent even if I wanted to.

opts.en: independence, standing on one's own feet

items.why: Living on your own money = 自立 (the book: 親の家を出て自立する).

items.q: ④日本人はよく、あまり（ ）主張をしないと言われる。
items.qr: Nihonjin wa yoku, amari (___) shuchou o shinai to iwareru.
items.en: It is often said that Japanese people don't assert themselves much.

opts.en: independence, standing on one's own feet

items.why: 自己主張 (self-assertion) is the book's compound.

items.q: ⑤この商品は、全部一緒に箱に入れないで（ ）に包装してください。
items.qr: Kono shouhin wa, zenbu issho ni hako ni irenaide (___) ni housou shite kudasai.
items.en: Please don't put these items all in one box — wrap them individually.

opts.en: independence, standing on one's own feet

items.why: The opposite of 全部一緒に = 個別に, one by one (the book: 個別に指導する).

items.q: ①ビザを更新する（ ）は、もう終わりましたか。
items.qr: Biza o koushin suru (___) wa, mou owarimashita ka.
items.en: Have you finished the procedure for renewing your visa?
items.why: Paperwork for a visa = 手続き (the book: 入学の手続きをする).

items.q: ②庭の（ ）をするのは、いつも祖父の役目だった。
items.qr: Niwa no (___) o suru no wa, itsumo sofu no yakume datta.
items.en: Looking after the garden was always my grandfather's job.
items.why: Keeping something in good condition = 〜の手入れをする (the book: 髪・肌の手入れ).

items.q: ③あの店の品物は、値段も（ ）だし質も悪くない。
items.qr: Ano mise no shinamono wa, nedan mo (___) da shi shitsu mo warukunai.
items.en: The goods in that shop are reasonably priced and not bad in quality.
items.why: A price that is "just right" = 値段が手ごろ (the book: 手ごろな値段).

items.q: ④事務処理の仕事が多いので、（ ）よく進めないと時間内に終わらない。
items.qr: Jimu shori no shigoto ga ooi node, (___) yoku susumenai to jikannai ni owaranai.
items.en: There is a lot of office work, so unless you do it efficiently you won't finish in time.
items.why: 手際よく = efficiently, deftly (the book: 料理の手際がいい).

items.q: ⑤あそこに高い建物がありますね。郵便局はその（ ）にあります。
items.qr: Asoko ni takai tatemono ga arimasu ne. Yuubinkyoku wa sono (___) ni arimasu.
items.en: You see the tall building over there? The post office is just this side of it.
items.why: The side of something nearer to you = 手前 (the book's definition).

items.q: ①毎日、雨が降ったりやんだりの（ ）天気が続いている。
items.qr: Mainichi, ame ga futtari yandari no (___) tenki ga tsuzuite iru.
items.en: Every day this gloomy on-and-off rainy weather goes on.
items.why: Heavy, gloomy weather that weighs on your mood = うっとうしい天気.

items.q: ②日本語には発音がよく似ていて意味が違う（ ）言葉が多いと思う。
items.qr: Nihongo ni wa hatsuon ga yoku nite ite imi ga chigau (___) kotoba ga ooi to omou.
items.en: I think Japanese has many confusing words that sound alike but mean different things.
items.why: Easy to mistake for something else (似ていて) = まぎらわしい.

items.q: ③この文章は（ ）て、何が言いたいのかわからない。
items.qr: Kono bunshou wa (___) te, nani ga iitai no ka wakaranai.
items.en: This text is so convoluted I can't tell what it's trying to say.
items.why: Tangled and hard to follow = ややこしい. Before て: ややこしく(て).

items.q: ④彼は上司や同僚との付き合いが（ ）と言って、会社を辞めてしまった。
items.qr: Kare wa joushi ya douryou to no tsukiai ga (___) to itte, kaisha o yamete shimatta.
items.en: Saying that socialising with his boss and colleagues was a pain, he quit the company.
items.why: Social obligations that feel like a burden = 付き合いがわずらわしい.

items.q: ⑤人をだましてもうけたお金なんて、（ ）。
items.qr: Hito o damashite mouketa okane nante, (___).
items.en: Money made by cheating people — how disgusting.
items.why: Morally dirty, something you want nothing to do with = けがらわしい (汚らわしい).

items.q: ①（ ）必要なものはそろいました。あとは必要に応じて買っていきます。
items.qr: (___) hitsuyou na mono wa soroimashita. Ato wa hitsuyou ni oujite katte ikimasu.
items.en: For now I have the things I need. I'll buy the rest as and when needed.

opts.en: for the time being, first of all
at last, finally (the big moment has come)

items.why: "First, for the time being — the rest later" = とりあえず (the book: とりあえず住むところを決めた).

items.q: ②前売り券は、（ ）売り切れてしまいましたよ。
items.qr: Maeuriken wa, (___) urikirete shimaimashita yo.
items.en: The advance tickets sold out long ago.

opts.en: for the time being, first of all
at last, finally (the big moment has come)

items.why: Something finished long before now = とっくに (ずっと前に).

items.q: ③（ ）明日からは社会人、期待と不安で複雑な気持ちだ。
items.qr: (___) ashita kara wa shakaijin, kitai to fuan de fukuzatsu na kimochi da.
items.en: At last, from tomorrow I'm a working adult — I have mixed feelings of hope and anxiety.

opts.en: for the time being, first of all
at last, finally (the big moment has come)

items.why: A big moment finally arriving = いよいよ (the book: いよいよ明日は入学試験だ).

items.q: ④（ ）起きなさい。遅刻しますよ。
items.qr: (___) okinasai. Chikoku shimasu yo.
items.en: Get up right now. You'll be late.

opts.en: for the time being, first of all
at last, finally (the big moment has come)

items.why: Urging someone to act quickly without dawdling = さっさと (the book: さっさとかたづける).

items.q: ⑤二次会に参加ご希望の方は、（ ）お知らせください。
items.qr: Nijikai ni sanka gokibou no kata wa, (___) oshirase kudasai.
items.en: Anyone wishing to join the after-party, please let us know in advance.

opts.en: for the time being, first of all
at last, finally (the big moment has come)

items.why: Telling someone before the event = あらかじめ (事前に).

items.q: (1) 洗濯物をひたしておいてください。（ ）
items.qr: Sentakumono o hitashite oite kudasai.
items.en: Please leave the laundry soaking.
items.why: ひたす (浸す) = put something into liquid and leave it → 水につける. 水をかける only pours water over the surface.

items.q: (2) 彼女は思わず顔をおおった。（ ）
items.qr: Kanojo wa omowazu kao o ootta.
items.en: She instinctively covered her face.
items.why: おおう (覆う) = cover something so it can't be seen; 顔をおおう = hide the face with the hands → 手で隠した.

items.q: ①新人採用に関する（ ）は、人事部長が持っている。
items.qr: Shinjin saiyou ni kansuru (___) wa, jinji buchou ga motte iru.
items.en: The authority over hiring new staff lies with the head of personnel.
items.why: The power that comes with a specific post, over a specific matter = 権限 (the book: 人事に関する権限).

items.q: ②A教授は、日本語学の最高（ ）と言われている。
items.qr: A-kyouju wa, Nihongogaku no saikou (___) to iwarete iru.
items.en: Professor A is said to be the leading authority on Japanese linguistics.
items.why: A person who is the top expert in a field = 権威 (the book: その道の権威).

items.q: ③江戸時代には、将軍が絶大な（ ）を握っていた。
items.qr: Edo jidai ni wa, shougun ga zetsudai na (___) o nigitte ita.
items.en: In the Edo period, the shogun held immense power.
items.why: 権力を握る = seize/hold power (the book's collocation).

items.q: ④台風は（ ）を強めながら北上しています。
items.qr: Taifuu wa (___) o tsuyomenagara hokujou shite imasu.
items.en: The typhoon is moving north while gaining strength.
items.why: The strength of a typhoon = 勢力 — a standard weather-report phrase. 圧力 is physical or social pressure.

items.q: ⑤大統領を批判したその映画は、政府の（ ）で上映禁止となった。
items.qr: Daitouryou o hihan shita sono eiga wa, seifu no (___) de jouei kinshi to natta.
items.en: The film criticising the president was banned under government pressure.
items.why: Pressure applied from outside to force something = 圧力 (圧力をかける).

items.q: ①臨時ではなく、（ ）の職員として採用された。
items.qr: Rinji de wa naku, (___) no shokuin to shite saiyou sareta.
items.en: I was hired not as temporary but as regular staff.
items.why: The opposite of 臨時 (temporary) = 正規 (regular, official).

items.q: ②この道はマラソンのコースになっているため、交通（ ）が行われている。
items.qr: Kono michi wa marason no koosu ni natte iru tame, koutsuu (___) ga okonawarete iru.
items.en: This road is part of the marathon course, so traffic restrictions are in place.
items.why: Restricting something by rule = 規制 (the book: 交通量を規制する).

items.q: ③（ ）を破った学生は停学処分になることがある。
items.qr: (___) o yabutta gakusei wa teigaku shobun ni naru koto ga aru.
items.en: Students who break the rules may be suspended.
items.why: 規則を破る = break the rules (the book's collocation).

items.q: ④集団生活では、（ ）を乱すような行動はしてはいけない。
items.qr: Shuudan seikatsu de wa, (___) o midasu you na koudou wa shite wa ikenai.
items.en: In group living, you must not behave in ways that disturb discipline.
items.why: 規律を乱す = disturb order/discipline (the book's collocation).

items.q: ⑤彼は不正乗車をしたため、（ ）の料金の3倍をとられた。
items.qr: Kare wa fusei jousha o shita tame, (___) no ryoukin no sanbai o torareta.
items.en: Because he rode without a valid ticket, he was charged three times the standard fare.
items.why: A fixed, officially set amount = 規定の料金 (the book's example).

items.q: ①上司ならいいが、同僚から仕事の（ ）をされるのは気分が悪い。
items.qr: Joushi nara ii ga, douryou kara shigoto no (___) o sareru no wa kibun ga warui.
items.en: It's fine from a boss, but being told how to do my work by a colleague annoys me.
items.why: Giving orders about how to work = 指図 (the book: 指示・命令すること).

items.q: ②悪いことをしたときは、潔く認めた方がいい。（ ）はしないことだ。
items.qr: Warui koto o shita toki wa, isagiyoku mitometa hou ga ii. (___) wa shinai koto da.
items.en: When you've done wrong, it's best to admit it gracefully. Don't make excuses.
items.why: The opposite of admitting (認める) = 言い訳する, making excuses.

items.q: ③お会いする日程ですが、明日は（ ）が悪いんです。明後日はいかがですか。
items.qr: Oai suru nittei desu ga, ashita wa (___) ga warui n desu. Asatte wa ikaga desu ka.
items.en: About when to meet — tomorrow isn't convenient for me. How about the day after?
items.why: 都合が悪い = inconvenient (the book: 都合がいい・悪い).

items.q: ④結婚するとき、両親に反対されたが、時間をかけて（ ）し、許してもらった。
items.qr: Kekkon suru toki, ryoushin ni hantai sareta ga, jikan o kakete (___) shi, yurushite moratta.
items.en: My parents opposed my marriage, but I took my time persuading them and got their permission.
items.why: Talking someone round to your view = 説得する (the book's definition).

items.q: ⑤安全確認の（ ）を見て、運転士は電車を発車させた。
items.qr: Anzen kakunin no (___) o mite, untenshi wa densha o hassha saseta.
items.en: On seeing the all-clear signal, the driver started the train.
items.why: A signal you can see = 合図 (合図する).

items.q: ①相撲の優勝決定戦はたった2秒で（ ）終わってしまった。
items.qr: Sumou no yuushou ketteisen wa tatta nibyou de (___) owatte shimatta.
items.en: The sumo play-off for the title was over in just two seconds — what an anticlimax.

opts.en: no match for; can't win against

items.why: Over so fast it's a let-down = あっけない; as an adverb before 終わる → あっけなく.

items.q: ②昼食は済ませたけど、ちょっと（ ）からケーキでも食べよう。
items.qr: Chuushoku wa sumaseta kedo, chotto (___) kara keeki demo tabeyou.
items.en: I've had lunch, but it wasn't quite enough, so let's have some cake.

opts.en: no match for; can't win against

items.why: Something is missing, you want a bit more = ものたりない.

items.q: ③相手チームはみんな身長が2メートル以上だから、（ ）よ。
items.qr: Aite chiimu wa minna shinchou ga ni meetoru ijou da kara, (___) yo.
items.en: Everyone on the other team is over two metres tall — we're no match for them.

opts.en: no match for; can't win against

items.why: Unable to beat a stronger opponent = かなわない (敵わない).

items.q: ④彼の成功は、（ ）努力によって現実となった。
items.qr: Kare no seikou wa, (___) doryoku ni yotte genjitsu to natta.
items.en: His success became reality through unceasing effort.

opts.en: no match for; can't win against

items.why: Effort without a break = たえまない努力 (絶え間ない).

items.q: ⑤戦争中、生き延びるために我が子を手放した母親の話を聞いて、（ ）気持ちになった。
items.qr: Sensouchuu, ikinobiru tame ni waga ko o tebanashita hahaoya no hanashi o kiite, (___) kimochi ni natta.
items.en: Hearing the story of a mother who gave up her child during the war so it could survive, I felt heartbroken.

opts.en: no match for; can't win against

items.why: A painful, aching sadness = せつない気持ち (切ない).

items.q: ①（ ）こんなに大きい会社が倒産するとは思わなかった。
items.qr: (___) konna ni ookii kaisha ga tousan suru to wa omowanakatta.
items.en: I never dreamed such a big company could go bankrupt.
items.why: まさか〜とは思わなかった is the book's pattern: something you couldn't believe.

items.q: ②1人で国内旅行もできないのに、（ ）海外一人旅なんて、考えられない。
items.qr: Hitori de kokunai ryokou mo dekinai no ni, (___) kaigai hitoritabi nante, kangaerarenai.
items.en: I can't even travel around my own country alone, let alone go abroad by myself — unthinkable.
items.why: Even A is impossible, so B is all the more so = まして (the book: ○○でさえ〜、まして××は…).

items.q: ③彼こそ（ ）一国の指導者にふさわしい人物だ。
items.qr: Kare koso (___) ikkoku no shidousha ni fusawashii jinbutsu da.
items.en: He is truly the right person to lead a nation.
items.why: 〜こそまさに = exactly, truly (本当にそのとおり).

items.q: ④受験する人は、（ ）試験会場に行ってみたほうがいいですよ。
items.qr: Juken suru hito wa, (___) shiken kaijou ni itte mita hou ga ii desu yo.
items.en: If you're taking the exam, it's a good idea to visit the venue beforehand.
items.why: Before the exam day = まえもって (前もって, in advance).

items.q: ⑤久しぶりにクラス会があり、（ ）学生時代にもどったような気がした。
items.qr: Hisashiburi ni kurasukai ga ari, (___) gakusei jidai ni modotta you na ki ga shita.
items.en: We had a class reunion after a long time, and it felt as if I'd gone back to my school days.
items.why: まるで〜ような = as if (the book: まるで〜のようだ).

items.q: (1) 次のテストでは、漢字のふりがなをはぶくことにした。（ ）
items.qr: Tsugi no tesuto de wa, kanji no furigana o habuku koto ni shita.
items.en: We decided to leave out the furigana on the kanji in the next test.
items.why: はぶく (省く) = leave out → 省略する (the same kanji 省).

items.q: (2) たくさん作ったご飯が、あまってしまった。（ ）
items.qr: Takusan tsukutta gohan ga, amatte shimatta.
items.en: I made lots of rice, and some was left over.
items.why: あまる (余る) = there is more than needed, some remains → 残る. なくなる is the opposite.

items.q: ①なぜこんなことをやるのだろう。彼らは何を（ ）しているのだろう。
items.qr: Naze konna koto o yaru no darou. Karera wa nani o (___) shite iru no darou.
items.en: Why would they do this? What are they aiming at?
items.why: What someone is trying to achieve = 〜を意図する (the book: 意図して〜する).

items.q: ②彼女は（ ）が強いので、やろうと思ったことは最後までやるだろう。
items.qr: Kanojo wa (___) ga tsuyoi node, yarou to omotta koto wa saigo made yaru darou.
